hooks.name: ResetProfileState
hooks.portable_default: Clear the 24 absolute scalar registers, temporary queues, P1 through P7, the stored machine execution mask, and bounded memory; retain hardwired all-ones P0; invalidate every TileInfo; set VERSION to 1 and TILE_CAPACITY to 256 KiB; reset time to zero; and enter ACR0.
profile_obligations: Reset all architecturally visible PTO v0 reference-profile state to the values stated in the implementation.

hooks.name: SystemRegisterAccessPermitted
hooks.portable_default: Permit base system registers at every ACR and require ACR0 for context, translation, and debug families.
profile_obligations: Define the ACR order, reset ring, protected register classes, and denied-access fault behavior.

hooks.name: ReadMonotonicTime
hooks.portable_default: Return the architectural cycle counter.
profile_obligations: Define the time unit, monotonicity guarantee, rollover behavior, and reset value.

hooks.name: FloatingExponential
hooks.portable_default: Evaluate the fixed 18-term PTO v0 Taylor reference algorithm.
profile_obligations: Define accuracy, exceptional inputs, overflow, underflow, and rounding.

hooks.name: FloatingRoundNearest
hooks.portable_default: Round to nearest with halfway cases selecting the even integer.
profile_obligations: Define tie handling and prove consistency with the selected scalar numeric profile.

hooks.name: ScalarFPBinaryProfile
hooks.portable_default: Apply deterministic modular carrier ADD, SUB, MUL, or DIV; zero DIV returns all ones and DZ. Scalar dispatch owns MIN/MAX NaN and signed-zero behavior.
profile_obligations: Consume the resolved active scalar rounding mode and round ADD, SUB, MUL, and DIV once at the destination-format boundary for every accepted scalar format.
Define NaN propagation, infinities, subnormals, signed zero, and NV/DZ/OF/UF/NX flags.

hooks.name: ScalarFPUnaryProfile
hooks.portable_default: Apply deterministic carrier ABS, identity SQRT, increment EXP, or unsigned reciprocal; zero reciprocal returns all ones and DZ.
profile_obligations: Consume the resolved active scalar rounding mode and round SQRT, reciprocal, and exponential once at the destination-format boundary; define the exact or bounded mathematical result.
Define exceptional inputs, approximation guarantees, and NV/DZ/OF/UF/NX flags.

hooks.name: ScalarFPFusedProfile
hooks.portable_default: Apply one modular word-width multiply followed by the selected signed addend transform.
profile_obligations: Evaluate the exact fused multiply-add expression and apply the resolved active scalar rounding mode once at the destination-format boundary for every accepted scalar format.
Define NaN propagation and NV/OF/UF/NX flags.

hooks.name: ScalarFPToIntegerProfile
hooks.portable_default: Return the source payload before normative destination-width normalization and no new flags.
profile_obligations: Use the fixed mnemonic rounding mode once before range handling; define saturation or indefinite results, exceptional inputs, and NV/NX flags for every accepted integer destination type.

hooks.name: ScalarFPConvertProfile
hooks.portable_default: Return the source payload before normative floating destination-width normalization and no new flags.
profile_obligations: Apply the resolved active scalar rounding mode once at the destination-format boundary; define NaN payload handling, overflow, underflow, and flags for every accepted destination type.

hooks.name: ScalarIntegerToFPProfile
hooks.portable_default: Return the normalized integer source payload before normative floating destination-width normalization and no new flags.
profile_obligations: Apply the resolved active scalar rounding mode once at the destination-format boundary; define overflow, underflow, and NX flags for every accepted destination type.

hooks.name: TileSquareRoot
hooks.portable_default: Return the raw input payload.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE once at the destination boundary; define per-data-type square-root encoding, accuracy, and exceptional inputs.

hooks.name: TileLogarithm
hooks.portable_default: Return the raw input payload.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE once at the destination boundary; define per-data-type logarithm encoding, base, accuracy, and exceptional inputs.

hooks.name: TileReciprocal
hooks.portable_default: Apply unsigned bitvector reciprocal and reject zero.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE once at the destination boundary; define per-data-type reciprocal encoding, accuracy, and division-by-zero behavior.

hooks.name: TileExponential
hooks.portable_default: Increment the raw input payload by one modulo XLEN.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE once at the destination boundary; define per-data-type exponential encoding, base, accuracy, overflow, and underflow.

hooks.name: TileExpDifference
hooks.portable_default: Subtract the raw right payload from the raw left payload.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE once at the destination boundary; define the exponential-difference formula, intermediate precision, and exceptional inputs for every accepted floating type.

hooks.name: TileProfileConvert
hooks.portable_default: Preserve the raw payload for conversions involving a floating type.
profile_obligations: Consume NumericExecutionControl, apply the TCVT operation default or explicit mode once at the destination boundary, then saturate; define accepted type pairs, packing, nonsaturating range results, and exceptional values.

hooks.name: TileProfileQuantize
hooks.portable_default: Apply unsigned bitvector division by scale, add zero point, and normalize to the destination integer width.
profile_obligations: Consume NumericExecutionControl, round once after the affine quantization expression, then saturate; define scale and zero-point encodings, clamping values, per-type legality, and zero-scale behavior.

hooks.name: TileProfileDequantize
hooks.portable_default: Subtract the zero point and multiply by scale as raw bitvectors.
profile_obligations: Consume NumericExecutionControl, round once after the dequantization expression at the destination boundary, then saturate; define scale and zero-point encodings, intermediate precision, and per-type legality.

hooks.name: ExtensionFirstUseEnabled
hooks.portable_default: Return false for VECTOR and CUBE so portable PTO execution never raises an extension first-use trap.
profile_obligations: Define the covered extension kinds and their enable-state ownership.
Define source and manager ACR routing and the exact pre-effect ordering point.
Keep the enable query readonly and stable for one decoded instruction attempt.

hooks.name: RaiseExtensionFirstUse
hooks.portable_default: Return false without changing trap, bundle, queue, memory, or fault state.
profile_obligations: Define the exact trap envelope and extension-kind argument mapping.
Raise before extension resource allocation, memory issue, queue mutation, or any other architectural effect.
Preserve the original instruction for retry and guarantee context-save forward progress.

hooks.name: SaveTrapContext
hooks.portable_default: Save TPC, BPC, bundle-control state, and trap argument state for a target access-control ring.
profile_obligations: Define which context fields are banked, which ring may save them, and whether partial context save is possible.

hooks.name: RecoverTrapContext
hooks.portable_default: Restore TPC, BPC, bundle-control state, and trap argument state for a target access-control ring when a saved context is valid.
profile_obligations: Define context validity, failed recovery behavior, and restored field set.

hooks.name: AtomicAddress
hooks.portable_default: Preserve the decoded address for both address-class hint values.
profile_obligations: Define address-class selection, translation, fault priority, and interaction with reservations for both hint values.

hooks.name: TranslateDataAddress
hooks.portable_default: Use identity translation for scalar data accesses.
profile_obligations: Define translation inputs, address-space selection, access-size behavior, and translation-fault priority.
Return a stable translated address for every repeated probe of one architectural access during an instruction.
Remain readonly: address translation cannot mutate architectural state during an access probe.

hooks.name: DataAccessPermitted
hooks.portable_default: Permit ACR0 and ACR1 access to all bounded memory and restrict ACR2 through ACR15 to bytes 0 through 3071.
profile_obligations: Define read/write permissions, bounds, access-size behavior, and permission-fault priority.
Return a stable permission decision for every repeated probe of one architectural access during an instruction.
Remain readonly: permission checks cannot mutate architectural state during an access probe.

hooks.name: TileProfileBinary
hooks.portable_default: Apply the operation with deterministic raw bitvector arithmetic.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE once at each floating destination boundary and no rounding for exact integer or bitwise results; define exceptional values, overflow, and underflow.

hooks.name: TileProfileUnary
hooks.portable_default: Apply the operation with deterministic raw bitvector behavior.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE once at each floating destination boundary and no rounding for exact sign, bitwise, or selection results; define exceptional values, overflow, and underflow.

hooks.name: TileProfileCompare
hooks.portable_default: Compare raw payloads with deterministic signed or equality relations.
profile_obligations: Define per-type ordering, equality, NaN behavior, signed-zero behavior, and unordered results.

hooks.name: TileProfileReductionInitial
hooks.portable_default: Initialize reduction accumulators from the first raw payload.
profile_obligations: Initialize in increasing logical row-major order without rounding the selected first element; define per-type identities, exceptional values, and empty-input legality.

hooks.name: TileProfileReductionStep
hooks.portable_default: Apply raw bitvector sum, product, minimum, maximum, or argument selection.
profile_obligations: Use increasing logical row-major order and operation-fixed RNE after each floating sum or product step; define accumulation precision, exceptional values, and tie selection.

hooks.name: TileProfileExpand
hooks.portable_default: Apply the selected expansion operation with raw bitvector arithmetic.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE once at each floating arithmetic destination and no rounding for broadcast or selection results; define exceptional values, overflow, and underflow.

hooks.name: TileProfilePartialValue
hooks.portable_default: Apply partial arithmetic with deterministic raw bitvector operations.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE after each floating partial add or multiply step and no rounding for min/max selection; define exceptional values and missing-source behavior.

hooks.name: TileProfileOrderLeft
hooks.portable_default: Order raw payloads as signed words and prefer the left operand on ties.
profile_obligations: Define per-type ordering, NaN behavior, signed-zero behavior, stability, and tie selection.

hooks.name: TileProfileValueIsNaN
hooks.portable_default: Classify no raw carrier as NaN in the deterministic PTO v0 reference profile.
profile_obligations: Define NaN classification for every floating Tile data type used by stable TSORT ordering.

hooks.name: TileProfileMatrixAccumulate
hooks.portable_default: Multiply raw payloads and accumulate at architectural word width.
profile_obligations: Use operation-fixed RNE for each fused multiply-add in increasing logical K order; define accepted type triples, product and accumulator widths, saturation, and exceptional values.

hooks.name: TileProfileMatrixBias
hooks.portable_default: Add bias and destination raw payloads at architectural word width.
profile_obligations: Add bias after the complete dot product and use operation-fixed RNE at the accumulator boundary; define accepted type pairs, bias conversion, saturation, and exceptional values.

hooks.name: TileProfileMatrixScaledAccumulate
hooks.portable_default: Scale the left and right raw operands at word width, multiply the scaled operands, and add the term to the unscaled prior accumulator.
profile_obligations: Apply scale before each fused multiply-add, visit K in increasing logical order, and use operation-fixed RNE at each accumulator step; define exact MX pairs, E8M0 decoding, accumulator precision, saturation, and exceptional values.

hooks.name: TileProfileMatrixPostProcess
hooks.portable_default: Preserve the raw carrier value through the named matrix post-process hook; PTO-v0 does not select target FP19 arithmetic.
profile_obligations: Define FP19 conversion, rounding boundary, exceptional values, overflow, saturation, quantization offsets, activation behavior, and output encodings for every accepted PreQuantMode/ReluMode/type tuple.

hooks.name: TileProfileMatrixReductionStep
hooks.portable_default: Reuse registered TileProfileUnary ABS and TileProfileReductionStep MAX on raw carriers, selecting the candidate on equal/non-NaN maxima per the reference profile.
profile_obligations: Define FP19 absolute-value and reduction folding, signed zero/NaN behavior, partial groups, GroupN>N tails, and output encoding for every accepted matrix type.
